comparison.objective: Snap every sector of a drink lid onto a full paper cup without tipping or crushing it.
comparison.physical_skill: Progressive force-controlled snap fitting around a fragile rim.
comparison.success_condition: All eight sectors seated, cup undamaged and correctly placed, hands clear, stable for 1 s. No material rubric detail missing.
comparison.reason: Although both require controlled force and release, lid snap fitting does not test size-selective separation of loose bodies.
